claims.statement: Plutarch describes Octavia arriving in Athens with money, clothing and soldiers for Antony. He told her to remain there. This records a particular journey in the breakdown of their marriage and political alliance. It does not provide a complete itinerary.

Octavia brings support to Athens: 35 BCE to 35 BCE. The Loeb edition’s footnote dates the arrival to 35 BCE. The map uses the Acropolis to locate Athens, not to claim that Octavia visited that monument.
Acropolis reference within Athens; not evidence of a visit to the monument.
